nodes.label: Support Services Bridge
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Critical middle layer comprising environmental monitoring, specialised finance, and strategic communications — connects land-dwellers to complex market traders; without this the duet remains theoretical

nodes.label: Circular Peer-Review Accountability System
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Sites review each other in a fixed circular chain (Nkoroi+Seme→Molo→Woodland Valley→Hannacroix→Mwasama→Himo→Lukenya→Msi-Choke→Seme) — prevents top-down dependency and builds internal professional trust

nodes.label: Site Communications Administrator (SCA)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Role responsible for quarterly reporting in English and Kiswahili, weekly social media narrative, quarterly opinion-shaper engagement, and monthly digital coordination — bridges site activity to policy influence

nodes.label: Barbets Revolving Kitty Fund
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Competitive low-interest internal loan fund for value-addition projects, overseen by a partner verification panel — provides credit outside commercial banking constraints

nodes.label: Barbets Game (Biodiversity Board Game)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Rule-invention board game where winner achieves greatest biodiversity — used to train civil servants (tested in Singapore) and students in biodiversity-centred decision-making; a knowledge management tool

nodes.label: Developmental Hypothesis (2018)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: Posits that replacing rain-fed dependence with drip irrigation, water harvesting, and permaculture will achieve transformational change at individual and societal levels — operationalised at Seme site

nodes.label: 20-Year Operational Experiment (2008–2028)
nodes.source_file: pastebin/textual/Strategic Framework for the Barbets Duet Learning Site Network_ A 20-Year Operational Experiment.md
nodes.rationale: A structured multi-generational experiment to prove that life value of a landscape can be translated to rigorous market value through institutional innovation — half-time reviewed at 2018 Bagamoyo convention
